headline: 边缘行者领跑影视双榜
headlineEn: Edgerunners Leads Both Film and TV Charts
summary: 今日0部新片上映，本周已有5部新电影入市。《赛博朋克：边缘行者》影视双榜领跑，《时光代理人》《水晶湖》持续高热；电影端《换母疑云》《害群之马》受关注，待映含《哥斯拉-0.0》《猫鼬》《克拉拉与太阳》。
summaryEn: No new movie opened today, with 5 new films this week. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners leads both film and TV heat, while Link Click and Crystal Lake stay hot; on the movie side, Mother Swap Mystery and Black Sheep draw attention. Upcoming: Godzilla-0.0, Mongoose, and Klara and the Sun.
